notes.title: Additional info
notes.text:
In fixed versions of 7.6, the following configuration option is available:

config vpn ssl setting
    set remote-https-cert-check \<no-check/warn-on-error/reject-on-error/>
end

The default behavior is warn-on-error. With reject-on-error, where there is certificate check error, a rejecting page would be presented, and the user's only option is to close the connection.

In fixed versions of 7.4 and 7.2, the certificate check is always enabled and cannot be disabled or changed. On a certificate error, a warning page lets the user accept the risk or close the connection.

remediations.details:
FortiOS 8.0: Not Applicable
FortiOS 7.6: Upgrade to 7.6.5 or above
FortiOS 7.4: Upgrade to 7.4.10 or above
